tools.name: list_lab_panels
tools.description: List Picardo’s blood test panels. Each has an ID for get_lab_panel and prepare_order_link, a summary, who it is for, how many tests everyone gets and their subtotal.

tools.name: get_lab_panel
tools.description: Get one Picardo panel: every test it includes, marking any for men only or women only, why the tests were chosen, preparation such as fasting, and the subtotal.

tools.name: search_lab_tests
tools.description: Search Picardo’s orderable Labcorp tests by test name, six-digit Labcorp code or topic word, for example "ferritin", "vitamin D" or "thyroid". Returns each test’s code for prepare_order_link, a short description, price, preparation and the panels that already order it for everyone.

tools.name: prepare_order_link
tools.description: Create a link to review a lab order on picardo.health for the chosen panels and tests. Nothing is ordered or saved here: the user reviews the order, enters their details and pays on the site. Returns the link, what it contains and anything that could not be included. Orders are for adults 18 and ove

tools.name: calculate
tools.description:
Run one of Picardo’s blood-test calculators on results the user gives, and read the result against Picardo’s biomarker guide. Put each value in `inputs` by its id. Numbers are in US units unless `units` is "si". Nothing is saved.
Calculators:
- a1c, A1c to average glucose: Converts HbA1c to estimate

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "calculate" is 2933 chars, far longer than this server's median (282). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
